subject: gk
question: What happens when old aged people get cataract?

options.text: Crystalline lens of people in old age becomes milky and cloudy
Crystalline lens of people in old age becomes clear and shiny

solution:
The correct answer is __**Crystalline lens of people in old age becomes milky and cloudy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Cataract development involves the clouding of the eye's crystalline lens, leading to decreased vision.
 
• This condition is most commonly related to aging, affecting a significant portion of the elderly population.
 
• Symptoms can include blurred vision, difficulty with bright lights, and seeing "halos" around lights.
 
• Treatment generally involves surgical removal of the cloudy lens and replacement with an artificial lens.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Cataracts are the leading cause of blindness worldwide.
 
• Factors contributing to cataract formation include age, diabetes, smoking, alcohol use, and prolonged exposure to sunlight.
 
• Preventative measures include wearing sunglasses and hats outdoors to protect eyes from UV rays, and maintaining a healthy lifestyle to reduce the risk of diabetes.
 
• Advancements in cataract surgery have made it one of the most successful and life-changing procedures available.
